construction: offline synthetic HTTP service with real registry, selectors, codecs, filesystem and media probes; not live gateway evidence

media_generation.PNG: image_sample.png: local Pillow RGB solid image, 3x2 pixels; see image_provenance.json
media_generation.WAV: stdlib wave: 8000 Hz, mono, 16-bit PCM, 1600 silent samples, 0.2 seconds
media_generation.MP4: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i color=c=blue:s=64x48:r=10:d=0.3 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p sample.mp4; tiny synthetic file generated in pytest tmp directory

tls_redirect: Ephemeral loopback HTTPS service and self-signed localhost certificate generated at test runtime by OpenSSL; requests trusts that certificate through temporary process environment. No certificate/private key committed.
artifact_flow: Actual structured LLM JSON is validated against script.schema.json. Actual image/video/audio paths feed asset_manifest and Backlot. Optional numeric prices are omitted, metadata cost_status unquoted. Existing legacy public checkpoint handoff explicitly requires human approval; script/assets remain awaiting_human and no creative stage is completed or approved by test outputs.
identity_and_cost: Visible deployment model aliases, all task/request IDs, timestamps and usage are synthetic. Mock POST counts verify client no-resubmit behavior, not vendor charging. Media dimensions/durations prove local probes, not a deployed model output promise.
live_status: NOT RUN: no usable deployment gateway address + NEW_API_KEY was found during source audit; deployment revision/plugins/permissions/balance/quality remain live opt-in checks owned by the deployer.
